basis: Authorize a bounded post-refresh quality pass for the sealed QA Pilot design-language refresh. Verify visual consistency, accessibility, responsive behavior, EN/FR language behavior, and static-browser custody boundaries across all QA Pilot browser asset pages. Prior epic EPIC-QA-PILOT-DESIGN-LANGUAGE-REFRESH-1 sealed at #136-#142. This is a new epic, not a continuation.

epic_sequence.purpose: Inventory all QA Pilot browser asset pages. Identify visual, accessibility, responsive, i18n, and custody-risk areas. Document validation gaps.
Validate and remediate keyboard nav, focus, semantics, headings, form labels, contrast, status messaging, lang toggle accessibility.
Create repeatable visual/page-state validation checklist or lightweight static harness covering all pages and core UI states.
Validate narrow/default/wide viewport behavior. Validate EN/FR language behavior across all pages. Remediate regressions.
Final whole-epic validation. Confirm design quality, accessibility, responsive, i18n, custody boundaries. Epic completion report.
